title: A Choir for the Crown Anew
author: Kestrel Ravensworth
blurb: Astrid Pemberton, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
